what: A worked example of the Dual-Risk DCF Calculator: two forecasts of the same asset, the examined one 10% below the benchmark in every year, both discounted at the benchmark rate.

fields.v_fair: present value of the benchmark forecast at c
fields.v_own: present value of the examined forecast at c
fields.gain: gain of capital over the whole horizon, (1+c)^h (K-1)
fields.c_eff: effective rate, closed form (1+c) K^(-1/h) - 1, a fraction a year
fields.c_eff_stream: effective rate solved on the yearly amounts, a fraction a year

cite_as: A. Papadogiannis (2026), "Dual-Risk DCF Calculator", version 1.1.0, Zenodo, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24465124, together with the article: A. Papadogiannis (2026), "From unified discounting to dual-risk: A new lens on DCF valuation", Finance Research Open 2(1), 100096, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.finr.2026.100096
